name: pulsar-ide-php
description: PHP language support for Pulsar using Intelephense

intelephense.title: Intelephense
intelephense.description: Settings for the Intelephense Language Server. If you have defined [an `intelephense.config.json` file](https://intelephense.com/docs#configuration) in the root of your project, **those settings are combined with these and take precedence** — the config file will **override** any settings specified here. Thus if any of these settings need to vary from project to project, it is better to put those into an `intelephense.config.json` file.

licenseKey.title: License Key
licenseKey.description: The license key to use to unlock premium Intelephense features. Can be omitted at the cost of a reduced feature set.

phpVersion.title: PHP Version
phpVersion.description: A semver-compatible string representing the version of PHP you are targeting. Used to tailor suggestions and diagnostics. PHP 5.3.0 and later are supported.

documentRoot.title: Document Root
documentRoot.description: The directory containing your application’s entry point (the directory that holds `index.php`). May be absolute or relative to the project root. Used when resolving script inclusion and path suggestions.

includePaths.title: Include Paths
includePaths.description: A comma-separated list of paths, as defined in the `include_path` INI setting, or paths to external libraries. Each may be absolute or relative to the project root.

shortOpenTag.title: Short Open Tag
shortOpenTag.description: When enabled, `<?` will be parsed as a PHP open tag.

associations.title: Associations
associations.description: A comma-separated list of glob patterns describing which files should be made available to language server features.

exclude.title: Additional Excluded Paths
exclude.description:
A comma-separated list of glob patterns describing files and folders that should be excluded from all language server features.

These are added to whatever you have configured in Pulsar’s own **Ignored Names** setting (`core.ignoredNames`), so there is no need to repeat those entries here.

maxSize.title: Maximum File Size
maxSize.description: The largest file size, in bytes, that the language server will index. Larger files are ignored.

completion.title: Completion
completion.description: Settings that affect the suggestions returned by the language server. See also the **Autocomplete** section below.

insertUseDeclaration.title: Insert Use Declaration
insertUseDeclaration.description: When enabled, accepting a suggestion for a namespaced class, trait, interface, function, or constant will automatically insert a `use` declaration for it.

fullyQualifyGlobalConstantsAndFunctions.title: Fully Qualify Global Constants and Functions
fullyQualifyGlobalConstantsAndFunctions.description: When enabled, constants and functions in the global namespace will be fully qualified (prefixed with a backslash) when inserted.

triggerParameterHints.title: Trigger Parameter Hints
triggerParameterHints.description: When enabled, method and function suggestions will include parentheses and will trigger signature help.

suggestObjectOperatorStaticMethods.title: Suggest Static Methods After Object Operator
suggestObjectOperatorStaticMethods.description: PHP allows static methods to be called with the object operator — e.g. `$obj->myStaticMethod()`. Disable this if you’d rather not be offered static methods in that context.

withMethodBody.title: Complete Methods With a Body
withMethodBody.description: When enabled, method suggestions will include either a `parent` call or a `throw new Exception('Not implemented')` in the method body.

withOverrideAttribute.title: Complete Methods With an Override Attribute
withOverrideAttribute.description: When enabled, method suggestions will include an `#[Override]` attribute where appropriate — but only when targeting PHP 8.3 or later.

maxItems.title: Maximum Items
maxItems.description: The maximum number of suggestions returned for a single request.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Settings that control which diagnostics the language server produces. See also the **Linter** section below, which controls how those diagnostics are presented.

run.title: Run Diagnostics
run.description: When the language server should analyze a buffer for problems.

embeddedLanguages.title: Embedded Languages
embeddedLanguages.description: Whether to report diagnostics for HTML, CSS, and JavaScript embedded within PHP files.

enum.description: Only variables local to the current scope

undefinedVariables.title: Undefined Variables
undefinedVariables.description: Whether to report references to undefined variables.

undefinedTypes.title: Undefined Types
undefinedTypes.description: Whether to report references to undefined classes, interfaces, and traits.

undefinedFunctions.title: Undefined Functions
undefinedFunctions.description: Whether to report references to undefined functions.

undefinedConstants.title: Undefined Constants
undefinedConstants.description: Whether to report references to undefined constants.

undefinedClassConstants.title: Undefined Class Constants
undefinedClassConstants.description: Whether to report references to undefined class constants.

undefinedMethods.title: Undefined Methods
undefinedMethods.description: Whether to report references to undefined methods.

undefinedProperties.title: Undefined Properties
undefinedProperties.description: Whether to report references to undefined properties.

suppressUndefinedMembersWhenMagicMethodD.title: Suppress Undefined Members When Magic Method Declared
suppressUndefinedMembersWhenMagicMethodD.description: When enabled, undefined property and method diagnostics are suppressed on classes that declare a `__get` or `__call` magic method.

unusedSymbols.title: Unused Symbols
unusedSymbols.description: Whether to report unused variables, unused private members, and unused imports.

duplicateSymbols.title: Duplicate Symbols
duplicateSymbols.description: Whether to report symbols that are declared more than once.

enum.description: Only for functions and methods declared in your project

argumentCount.title: Argument Count
argumentCount.description: Whether to report calls made with the wrong number of arguments.

typeErrors.title: Type Errors
typeErrors.description: Whether to report type incompatibilities in arguments, property assignments, and return statements where types have been declared.

memberAccess.title: Member Access
memberAccess.description: Whether to report errors associated with accessing members of a type — for instance, reading a `private` property from outside its class.

implementationErrors.title: Implementation Errors
implementationErrors.description: Whether to report problems with method and class implementations, such as unimplemented abstract methods or incompatible method signatures.

languageConstraints.title: Language Constraints
languageConstraints.description: Whether to report violations of various language-level constraints.

deprecated.title: Deprecated
deprecated.description: Whether to report usage of symbols marked as deprecated.

unreachableCode.title: Unreachable Code
unreachableCode.description: Whether to report code that can never be executed.

suspectCode.title: Suspect Code
suspectCode.description: Whether to report irregularities that may indicate a bug — for instance, an assignment within a conditional expression, or a duplicate array key.

relaxedTypeCheck.title: Relaxed Type Check
relaxedTypeCheck.description: When enabled, a contravariant (wider) type will satisfy a type constraint. This makes type checking less thorough, which is useful in projects with incomplete or inaccurate type information. Disable it for stricter checking.

noMixedTypeCheck.title: No Mixed Type Check
noMixedTypeCheck.description: When enabled, type checking is skipped for the `mixed` type. Disable it to make type checking more thorough by requiring `mixed` to satisfy a type constraint explicitly.

strictTypes.title: Strict Types
strictTypes.description: When enabled, type checks are performed as though every file declared `declare(strict_types=1)`.

format.title: Formatting
format.description: Settings that affect how the language server formats code. See also the **Code Formatting** section below.

braces.title: Brace Style
braces.description: The brace placement style to use when formatting.

exclude.title: Exclude
exclude.description: A comma-separated list of glob patterns describing files and folders that should be excluded when searching for references.

exclude.title: Exclude
exclude.description: A comma-separated list of glob patterns describing files and folders that should be excluded when renaming a symbol. A rename will fail if the symbol’s definition lives in an excluded file.

namespaceMode.title: Namespace Mode
namespaceMode.description: How much of a namespace to affect when renaming part of one.

phpdoc.title: PHPDoc
phpdoc.description: Settings that affect the PHPDoc blocks generated by the **Add PHPDoc** code action.

returnVoid.title: Return Void
returnVoid.description: Whether to add `@return void` to generated PHPDoc for definitions that do not return a value.

useFullyQualifiedNames.title: Use Fully Qualified Names
useFullyQualifiedNames.description: When enabled, types in generated PHPDoc will be fully qualified. When disabled, short names will be used and imported where appropriate. Overrides **Insert Use Declaration** above.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: When enabled, anonymous usage and crash data will be sent to Intelephense’s vendor via Azure Application Insights.

enable.title: Enable
enable.description: When checked, will act as an `autocomplete-plus` provider and suggest completions for things you type.

enable.title: Enable
enable.description:
Whether to enable automatic code formatting. When disabled, this package will not act as a code formatting provider under any circumstances. When enabled, you must still have a package such as `pulsar-code-format` to implement code formatting and to control whether it is applied on save, while you type, or only when you ask for it.

(Takes effect after a window reload or a restart of Pulsar.)

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: The priority of this code formatting provider. Consumer packages use priority to decide which provider should “win” if several are available for a given task.

linter.title: Linter
linter.description: Settings that control how diagnostics are presented. To control which diagnostics are produced in the first place, see **Intelephense → Diagnostics** above.

enable.title: Enable
enable.description: Whether to show diagnostic messages via the `linter` package. (To change this setting for a specific kind of file, use a scoped setting.)

includeMessageCodeInMessageBody.title: Include Message Code in Message Body
includeMessageCodeInMessageBody.description: When enabled, will include the code for a linter message at the end of its body. Intelephense’s codes look like `P1009`.

symbols.title: Symbols
symbols.description:
Configures how this package talks to the `symbols-view` package — the core package that lets you jump to specific methods, classes, and other symbols, either in the current file or project-wide.

Depending on what other Pulsar packages you have installed, another package might get picked to provide symbols over this one; you can tweak this behavior via the **Prefer Certain Providers** setting in the `symbols-view` package settings.

enable.title: Enable
enable.description: Whether to provide symbols for the current file, for project-wide symbol search, and for going to the definition of a symbol. (To change this setting for a specific kind of file, use a scoped setting.)

enableForFileSymbols.title: Enable For File Symbols
enableForFileSymbols.description: Whether to act as a provider for file symbols. Has no effect unless **Enable** is also checked.

enableForProjectSymbols.title: Enable For Project Symbols
enableForProjectSymbols.description: Whether to act as a provider for project symbols. Affects the `symbols-view` commands **Toggle Project Symbols** and **Go To Declaration**. Has no effect unless **Enable** is also checked.

ignoredTags.title: Ignored Tags
ignoredTags.description:
A comma-separated list of tags that should be ignored when displaying a list of symbols (such as for the **Symbols View: Toggle File Symbols** command).

A symbol’s tag is the text in the rightmost badge for its entry in the symbols list — but lowercase. For example: to ignore variables, add `variable` to this list.

minimumQueryLength.title: Minimum Query Length
minimumQueryLength.description: The minimum number of characters a user must type on a **project-wide symbol search** before the request is forwarded to the language server.

enable.title: Enable
enable.description: Whether to act as a hover information provider via the `datatip` and `hover` services. Hover information offers useful context for tokens under the cursor or mouse pointer. (Takes effect after a window reload or a restart of Pulsar.)

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: The priority of this hover information provider. Consumer packages use priority to decide which provider should “win” if several are available for a given task.

enable.title: Enable
enable.description: Whether to act as a signature help provider. Signature help describes the parameters of the function or method whose argument list you are currently editing. (Takes effect after a window reload or a restart of Pulsar.)

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: The priority of this signature help provider. Consumer packages use priority to decide which provider should “win” if several are available for a given task.

memoryLimit.title: Memory Limit
memoryLimit.description:
The maximum size of V8’s old memory section in megabytes, corresponding to `--max-old-space-size` on the command line. For example: a value of `4096` means 4 gigabytes. A value of `0` is equivalent to not specifying this option. Raise this if the language server runs out of memory on a large project.

(Takes effect the next time the language server starts.)

symbol.provider.description: Allows external sources to suggest symbols for a given file or project.
